bio.text: Seth Bodnar, a former president of the University of Montana, is running as an independent for the U.S. Senate from Montana in 2026.
He led the university for eight years before resigning the post.
According to his campaign website, he graduated from West Point, studied at Oxford as a Rhodes Scholar, deployed to Iraq as an infantry officer and served as a Green Beret.

sources.title: Former UM President Seth Bodnar discusses independent bid for U.S. Senate
A surprise resignation could open the door for an independent to win a Montana Senate seat
